title: Germany Issues Joint Federal PQC Migration Guidelines to Align with EU Post-Quantum Roadmap - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Germany's BMDS, BMI and BSI published joint national guidelines for migrating to post-quantum cryptography, operationalizing the EU roadmap with phased deadlines: readiness by end of 2026, high-risk systems by 2030 and nearly everything by 2035.

insights.claim: Germany's joint BMDS, BMI and BSI guidelines set a three-phase PQC migration: readiness (inventories, governance, binding deadlines) by end of 2026, mandatory migration of high-risk systems by 2030, and full migration of medium and low-risk systems by 2035.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Defined deadlines create a multi-year demand window for PQC, crypto-inventory and PKI vendors in Germany.
insights.locator: Germany Federal PQC Migration Timeline table

insights.claim: Phase 1 requires federal, state, municipal and KRITIS entities to build cryptographic inventories (CBOMs) and catalogs, appoint migration leads and adopt legally binding deadlines via IT-Planungsrat and UP KRITIS.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Near-term compliance spend centers on cryptographic inventory tooling.

insights.claim: The guidelines enforce BSI TR-02102 compliance and hybrid mechanisms pairing classical algorithms with NIST-standardized PQC algorithms to address Store Now, Decrypt Later risk for long-lived data and long legacy replacement cycles.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hybrid key exchange and quantum-safe PKI are the concrete procurement targets.

insights.claim: Under Section 30 of the BSI Act, operators of critical and essential infrastructure must incorporate PQC readiness into their formal risk management frameworks.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Legal obligation turns PQC from optional to mandatory for infrastructure operators.
insights.locator: Under Section 30 of the BSI Act

insights.claim: The German framework directly operationalizes the EU's Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography, adopted by NIS Workstream member states in June 2025.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Other EU states are likely to follow with aligned national timelines.

insights.claim: The BSI says rapid AI advances are accelerating security research and attack methods against RSA and ECC, underscoring the need for crypto-agility.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: AI is cited as a driver of urgency, strengthening the case for early PQC migration.
